rationale: The message reports concrete observed YAML scalar conversion behavior from probing tests, without asking or directing action. It delivers the findings as results from experimentation, so evidence_observation is primary and result_delivery secondary.

evidence.text: More YAML scalar behavior: date `2020-01-01` -> JSON string `2020-01-01T00:00:00Z`; timestamp preserved; `1e3` -> 1000; `012` -> 10 (octal); yes remains string; null/~ -> null.
